parameters.native_integrity: sha256(FLAC bytes); sha256(interleaved native s16le payload)
parameters.analysis_channel: highest native RMS channel, zero-based; no downmix or spatial interpretation
parameters.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly; gcd ratio; default Kaiser beta=5.0

spectral.tilt_definition: linear least squares: 10log10 power versus log2 frequency

parameters.text_rate: language-specific written units / object duration or energy-active duration; not syllables, not forced alignment
parameters.uncertainty: all pitch and harmonicity values are signal estimates; no perceptual review; mixtures and estimator failures are flagged
